title: Meinya
description: A meinya pet from Made in Abyss in Minecraft would be a tiny, fluffy companion that follows you around and makes cute sounds.
body:
### Acquire your very own **Meinastilim** companion!

Meinastilims can be found in ** Lush Caves**, their natural habitat deep underground.

Meinyas love a variety of foods, including **raw salmon**, **raw fish**, **honeycomb**, **apples**, and **bread**. These can be used to tame and breed them.

If a Meinastilim dies, it will drop **Meinastilim Fur**. This rare material can be used in brewing to create Night Vision potions, helping you see clearly in the dark.

This mod is inspired by the manga and anime **Made in Abyss**.
